conservation.condition_narrative: "Sprayed with a solution of n-butyl isobutyl methacrylate copolymer resin as a final protective surface coating Jan. 1955" (blue-bordered typed label; date, black ink).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: (The Intimate Gallery, New York, NY); Mitchell Kennerley, New York, NY, 1928; (An American Place, New York, NY); The artist, return, 1931; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, Great Neck, New York, 1955; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 6782, lot no. 74, 29 November 1995; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Owings-Dewey Fine Art, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1995 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted 1923." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946" [note of backing inscription 1]. Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription 1.
titles.title: Calla Lily with Red Background

description: A bright white calla lily blossom spans the length and width of the composition. A narrow yellow spike rises from the center of the lily. The flower shines against a plain, dark red background.
title: Calla Lily with Red Background
